name: Totals Per Bank Transaction Code 5
definition: Set of elements used to provide the total sum of entries per bank transaction code.

NumberOfEntries.name: Number Of Entries
NumberOfEntries.definition: Number of individual entries for the bank transaction code.

Sum.name: Sum
Sum.definition: Total of all individual entries included in the report.

TotalNetEntry.name: Total Net Entry
TotalNetEntry.definition: Total debit or credit amount that is the result of the netted amounts for all debit and credit entries per bank transaction code.

CreditEntries.name: Credit Entries
CreditEntries.definition: Number of individual credit entries for the bank transaction code.

DebitEntries.name: Debit Entries
DebitEntries.definition: Number of individual debit entries for the bank transaction code.

ForecastIndicator.name: Forecast Indicator
ForecastIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the bank transaction code is related to booked or forecast items.

BankTransactionCode.name: Bank Transaction Code
BankTransactionCode.definition: Set of elements used to fully identify the type of underlying transaction resulting in an entry.

Availability.name: Availability
Availability.definition: Set of elements used to indicate when the booked amount of money will become available, that is can be accessed and starts generating interest.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Indicates the date (and time) of the transaction summary.
